thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms. The VIEWER, not a performer. Dark bedroom, a hand reaching past a phone to switch off the bedside lamp, bed already turned down. Pichwai/Kangra miniature, aged parchment, ornate border. Santoor may rest at frame edge, never the subject. Text in its own banner at ~35% of frame, second tier 'Santoor · Raga Bageshri'. 120px legible.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming - slow Indian classical santoor in Raga Bageshri, soft hammered strings with very long decay and sympathetic resonance carrying the sustain, no percussion, the feeling of a room going dark, 56 BPM, soft delta undertone.
suno_prompt_note: ⚠️ SPECCED AGAINST h_2026-09-05_3hr_tempo_retention_floor. 56 BPM is ABOVE the ~55 floor and Bageshri is NOT all-komal, deliberately avoiding the Malkauns-at-48-BPM spec that hit 7.2% AVD at d1. ⚠️ SOLO SANTOOR, no tanpura: adding a tanpura bed made this a packaging clone of the 2026-08-28 Santoor & Tanpura 3hr ship at 21 days. Santoor's own decay carries the sustain. CALM lane - no upbeat terms. No tabla.
